title: Creepy Korean fact: scared Koreans say their liver shrinks to a bean 🫘 #learnkorean
caption:
Creepy Korean fact 🫘 When Koreans get really scared, they say their liver shrinks to the size of a bean!

간이 콩알만 해지다 — not “my liver shrinks to a bean”: super scared
간 떨어지다 — not “my liver falls out”: totally startled
간이 크다 — not “a big liver”: fearless

Say it: 간이 콩알만 해졌어요 · 간 떨어질 뻔했어요 · 간이 크네요

alt: Felt mascot Mongle hosts a Korean idiom quiz. A tiny felt liver sitting in a row of kidney beans, a felt liver falling with speed lines, and a huge smiling felt liver show the literal readings of 간이 콩알만 해지다, 간 떨어지다 and 간이 크다; a pair of eyes peeking out from under a blanket next to a broken vase, an orange cat leaping at a thunderclap, and a TV showing a spooky moon with popcorn and a medal show the real meanings.
